type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype σ] {B : ℝ},
  1 ≤ B →
    ∀ {q r : σ → ℕ} {c : ℝ},
      (∀ R ∈ Roth.RSet B r,
          ∀ (h : σ → ℤ),
            (∀ (j : σ), IsCoprime (h j) ↑(q j)) →
              Roth.index ((map (Int.castRingHom ℝ)) R) (fun (j : σ) ↦ ↑(h j) / ↑(q j)) r ≤ c) →
        Roth.Θ B q r ≤ c
what: A supplied common upper bound on all admissible polynomial indices bounds their supremum Θ.
how: Apply csSup_le to the nonempty family from hB; destruct existential indexSet witnesses and apply hc.
hypotheses: Universe-polymorphic σ with Fintype; B real with 1≤B; arbitrary natural q,r; arbitrary real c; hc is the full pointwise upper bound. No DecidableEq, positive r, or positive q required.
mathlib_api_audit: NO-mathlib-has-it: independently verified csSup_le at the exact sSup parent. Old representation uses one mathlib call plus one project nonempty helper and logical witness transport; parent helper is not counted as a mathlib block.
moral_duplications: Structural supremum law shared with Real.sSup_le in Θ_le_card; unlike the preceding substantive bound, the full pointwise arithmetic premise is supplied here.
generalization: Abstract csSup_le handles arbitrary conditionally complete lattices and arbitrary nonempty sets. Fixed Θ/index interface retains Fintype. Replacing hB by 0≤c is verified using Real.sSup_le, and under hc, Θ≤c iff0≤c; no unconditional premise deletion claimed. Actual compiled Roth counterexample at B=0,c=-1 supplies hc vacuously but Θ=0 fails≤-1, so unconditional hB deletion is false; family-only emptiness legitimately omits Fintype.
